title: Craft Blend 4-Mix Trio #05 (L:부채꼴·매끈 / C:세로 띠·물결 / R:가로 띠·물결)
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio.

A photograph of THREE women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Iranian woman in her late 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, richly kohl-lined almond eyes, a deep berry-red lip, thick dark brows, warm olive skin, cheerful, bold vivid violet-purple hair styled in vintage victory rolls framing the face, real living eyes. Long oval nails, glossy finish.

Left woman's physique: An enormous, overwhelmingly muscular woman. Massive thick arms with heavy defined muscle, a broad powerful muscular back, a huge powerful chest, a heavy dense muscular torso and legs, only a soft hint of a waistline. Enormous round hips and colossal thick thighs with muscle visible through a soft layer, thick heavy calves. Not slim, not lean. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted with 4 different traditional patterns, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 4 wedge-shaped regions radiating from a single centre point located about 46% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure. 4 hazy ray-shaped transition zones leave that centre pointing toward 12 o'clock, 3 o'clock, 8 o'clock and 10 o'clock as seen by the camera, where 12 o'clock points straight up. Region 1 is the wedge between the 12 o'clock ray and the 3 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it is painted in Moroccan zellige tile mosaic (a deep cobalt ground with interlocking white, terracotta and gold motifs), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, dense interlocking star-and-cross motifs filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the wedge between the 3 o'clock ray and the 8 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it is painted in Turkish İznik tile (a brilliant white ground with cobalt-blue tulips and curling stems), wide cobalt-and-coral bands following the contours of the body, dense floral scrollwork filling the space between bands. Region 3 is the wedge between the 8 o'clock ray and the 10 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it is painted in French Limoges enamel (a deep cobalt-blue ground with fine white and gold grisaille scrollwork), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, dense grisaille scrollwork filling the space between bands. Region 4 is the wedge between the 10 o'clock ray and the 12 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it is painted in Nigerian Adire indigo resist-dye (a deep indigo-blue ground with bold white resist-dyed motifs), wide white bands following the contours of the body, dense spiral resist motifs filling the space between bands. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring patterns dissolve into each other, motifs from one thinning out as motifs from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one pattern, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. Pigment on living skin throughout, covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted.

Left woman's pose: both hands sweeping her hair back, every region clearly visible to the camera.

Left woman's footwear: extreme extreme platform thigh-skimming boots, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Center woman: a real adult Brazilian woman in her late 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, sun-bronzed glowing skin, gold and copper shimmer eyes, a glossy nude-coral lip, bold and confident, soft pastel-pink hair styled in braided, real living eyes. Long oval nails, glittery finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted with 4 different traditional patterns, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 4 vertical bands by 3 hazy transition zones centred about 20% of the way across her figure from her left edge, about 39% of the way across her figure from her left edge and about 74% of the way across her figure from her left edge. Region 1 is everything to her left of the first transition zone: it is painted in Finnish Iittala glass-inspired linework (a deep indigo ground with bold cream concentric ripple-line motifs), wide cream bands following the contours of the body, dense concentric ripple linework filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the strip between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Cubist-fragmented pattern (sharp angular asymmetric flat planes seen from several angles at once), wide silver bands following the contours of the body, dense angular fragment planes filling the space between bands. Region 3 is the strip between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it is painted in American Art Deco chrome-and-lacquer (a deep black lacquer ground with bold silver chrome sunburst), wide silver chrome bands following the contours of the body, dense zigzag linework filling the space between bands. Region 4 is everything to her right of the last transition zone: it is painted in Ethiopian cross-and-lattice gold pattern (a deep wine-red ground with fine gold lattice linework), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, dense lattice linework filling the space between bands. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring patterns dissolve into each other, motifs from one thinning out as motifs from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one pattern, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. Pigment on living skin throughout, covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted.

Center woman's pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body, every region clearly visible to the camera.

Center woman's footwear: extreme platform stiletto knee-high boots, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Right woman: a real adult Lebanese woman in her mid 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, radiant glowing bridal makeup, dramatic long lashes, a soft rose lip, warm fair skin, bold and confident, deep burgundy wine-red hair styled in high ponytail, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, glittery finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Every part of her is dramatically oversized at once: a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in sharply even at this size. Below that waistline, enormous round hips flare out more than three times the width of the waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, an overwhelming maximalist hourglass. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted with 4 different traditional patterns, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 4 horizontal bands by 3 hazy transition zones centred about 27% of the way down her figure from the top, about 47% of the way down her figure from the top and about 73% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it is painted in Mexican Talavera ceramic (a glossy white tin glaze with cobalt blue and marigold medallions), wide cobalt bands following the contours of the body, dense medallion scrollwork filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Croatian Hvar filigree-inspired linework (an ivory ground with fine cream and gold painted filigree linework), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, dense fine filigree linework filling the space between bands. Region 3 is the band between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it is painted in Filipino Yakan painted pattern (a black ground densely patterned with bright geometric diamond bands), wide magenta-and-gold bands following the contours of the body, dense geometric diamond work filling the space between bands. Region 4 is everything below the last transition zone: it is painted in Escher-inspired tessellation (a tessellating pattern of interlocking shapes that morph as they repeat), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, dense morphing tessellation filling the space between bands. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring patterns dissolve into each other, motifs from one thinning out as motifs from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one pattern, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. Pigment on living skin throughout, covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted.

Right woman's pose: both hands sweeping her hair back, every region clearly visible to the camera.

Right woman's footwear: extreme platform stiletto knee-high boots, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera.

Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against each woman's skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 8K.
